```{=html}
<div id="matter-adiabatic-lab" class="matter-lab adiabatic-lab">
  <div class="matter-lab-controls">
    <label>Initial potential A₀
      <span><output data-out="A0">5.5</output></span>
      <input data-control="A0" type="range" min="0.2" max="8" step="0.05" value="5.5">
    </label>
    <label>Profile length ΔX
      <span><output data-out="T">55</output></span>
      <input data-control="T" type="range" min="1" max="120" step="0.5" value="55">
    </label>
    <label>Vacuum mixing angle θ
      <span><output data-out="theta">33.4</output>°</span>
      <input data-control="theta" type="range" min="3" max="44" step="0.1" value="33.4">
    </label>
    <div class="matter-presets" role="group" aria-label="Profile speed">
      <button type="button" data-preset="slow">adiabatic</button>
      <button type="button" data-preset="fast">fast</button>
      <button type="button" data-preset="smallmix">small θ</button>
      <button type="button" data-action="play">▶ run profile</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="matter-lab-readouts">
    <div><span>max η</span><b data-val="eta">—</b></div>
    <div><span>min Δ<sub>m</sub>/Δ</span><b data-val="gap">—</b></div>
    <div><span>P<sub>2m</sub>(exit)</span><b data-val="P2m">—</b></div>
    <div><span>P<sub>2</sub>(exit)</span><b data-val="P2">—</b></div>
    <div class="prob"><span>P<sub>e</sub>(exit)</span><b data-val="Pe">—</b></div>
  </div>
  <div class="adiabatic-progress"><i data-progress></i></div>
  <div class="matter-lab-plots">
    <figure>
      <svg data-plot="profile" viewBox="0 0 610 285" role="img" aria-label="Density and probabilities in three bases"></svg>
      <figcaption>one wave, three decompositions</figcaption>
    </figure>
    <figure>
      <svg data-plot="branches" viewBox="0 0 440 285" role="img" aria-label="Following the instantaneous branch"></svg>
      <figcaption>exact state at the avoided crossing</figcaption>
    </figure>
  </div>
</div>
```
